description: Supervision prudentielle BCEAO & CIMA, surveillance du risque de crédit (NPL), ratios de solvabilité et alertes AML

charts.slice_name: Taux NPL par Pays (Prêts Douteux vs Seuil BCEAO 5%)
charts.query: SELECT country_code, loan_type, ROUND(npl_ratio * 100, 2) AS npl_percentage, risk_status FROM iceberg.gold.npl_ratio_by_country

charts.slice_name: Loss Ratio Assurance par Produit (Seuil CIMA 70%)
charts.query: SELECT product_line, country_code, ROUND(loss_ratio * 100, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct, is_cima_alert FROM iceberg.gold.loss_ratio_by_product

charts.slice_name: Volume d'Alertes AML par Jour et par Pays (Évolution 30 Jours)
charts.query: SELECT CAST(detection_timestamp AS DATE) AS event_date, country_code, COUNT(*) AS count__aml_events FROM kafka.default."gold-aml-events" GROUP BY CAST(detection_timestamp AS DATE), country_code ORDER BY event_date

charts.slice_name: Tableau de Bord des Sinistres : Délai Moyen vs SLA Contractuel (30j)
charts.query: SELECT country_code, product_line, avg_processing_days, ROUND(sla_breach_rate * 100, 2) AS sla_breach_rate_pct, total_processed_claims FROM iceberg.gold.claims_processing_time ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC
